findings.governingReading: 池 consistently identifies the bounded pond within the temple grounds.
findings.explanation: The temple pond is repeatedly enlarged into a lake.

findings.highlight: She fought many kinds of monsters
findings.evidenceJa: 様々な幻想種と戦う事も少なくはなかった
findings.governingReading: The narration says Saber fought many varieties of 幻想種, the same technical class named in the next sentence.
findings.explanation: Phantasmal Species become generic monsters in one line.

findings.highlight: The world's restraining power will be activated
findings.evidenceJa: それこそ抑止力が発動する
findings.governingReading: 抑止力 names the setting's technical corrective force expected to activate if the growth continues.
findings.explanation: The Counter Force is translated as the world's restraining power.

findings.evidenceJa: 少しずつ外へと移動する
findings.governingReading: Rin inches toward the outside while watching the tentacles; the next sentence says no exit exists.
findings.explanation: Moving outward becomes already going outside despite there being no exit.

findings.highlight: She smashes everything that gets in her way, whether it is a net, platform, or tentacles of meat
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女の行く手を阻む全てを粉砕する
findings.governingReading: Arrows from overhead shatter every tentacle, net, and platform obstructing her route.
findings.explanation: The raining arrows' destruction is assigned to Rin.

findings.highlight: In just a short time the black mud is repelled
findings.evidenceJa: ほんの僅かな時間ではあるが、黒い泥は弾かれ
findings.governingReading: ほんの僅かな時間ではあるが limits how long the arrows keep the black mud away.
findings.explanation: A momentary repulsion of the mud becomes a fast repulsion.

findings.highlight: with latent energy that shocks even her.
findings.evidenceJa: 自分でも呆れるぐらいの底力で
findings.governingReading: 底力 is last-ditch inner strength that surprises even her as she runs soaking wet.
findings.explanation: Rin's reserve of physical grit becomes latent energy after her mana is exhausted.

findings.highlight: Her magical energy replies to the screaming voice.
findings.evidenceJa: 叫ぶ声を、彼女の魔力が受け止める
findings.governingReading: Her mana catches/carries the shouted plea, enabling Saber to answer with the holy sword.
findings.explanation: Rin's magical energy receiving her cry becomes magical energy replying to it.
